concise_decision_de: Zyklus12 bleibt gesperrt, weil acht Resume-Versuche ohne bestätigte Veröffentlichung ausgeschöpft wurden; danach verweigert der Scheduler jeden neuen Zyklus mit operator_review_required.

Die archivierten HTTP503 sind signierte Sammelantworten des eigenen Import-Endpunkts: 7 unresolved und 1 unavailable. Eine konkrete fehlgeschlagene SQL-/Quellen-/Laufzeitstufe ist damit nicht bewiesen.
Die einzige unavailable-Antwort passt zur BG1-Zeitsperre um07:45UTC; das ist eine zeitliche Code-Hypothese, keine nachgewiesene historische Fehlerursache.

Die einzelne abgelaufene Job-Lease ist bislang nur aggregiert über subjects_v1 bekannt, ohne kind- oder CH→DE-Filter. Ohne Cycle12 operationId/leaseId und die deterministisch abgeleitete Job-/Claim-Familie darf sie Zyklus12 nicht zugeordnet werden.
Vor einem bindbaren Schreibpaket ist ein eng begrenzter separater READ-ONLY-Read für diese Identitäten, die native Originalverwahrung und die aktuellen Funktions-/Rechtebindungen erforderlich.

proven_observations.expired_research_leases_alias_definition: The archived SQL alias counts all subjects_v1 with current_job.state='leased' and expired lease.expiresAt, without a kind or CH-DE scope filter.

code_proven_interpretation.response_is_application_status: 503 is returned by /api/internal/readiness/ch-de-prod-refresh. It is not evidence of an HTTP503 from either official AA source.

accepted_signed_status.condition: A stored recognized outcome is selected only after exact response schema, phase, code/status/published tuple and HMAC checks; invalid/missing evidence is response_unconfirmed.
accepted_signed_status.inference: The persisted unresolved/unavailable outcomes are evidence that the scheduler accepted signed responses, assuming preserved function/history custody. This review cannot reverify deleted original response bytes.
early_unsigned_failures_excluded_as_comp: Missing/invalid production cron secret before request verification
Wrong release target/Supabase target before request verification
Request HMAC/authentication rejection before verified is set
An unsigned infrastructure-generated gateway503 by itself

signed_unavailable_paths.case: Abort after verified is set but before dispatched=true.
Method precheck returns unavailable (including admission/source/target checks) or throws before dispatched=true.
BG1 exclusion window; selected program/PG target mismatch; method read unavailable, malformed binding, receipt deadline or abort; rechecked exclusion window/backwards clock.
Selected request parsing fails or fixed facade is unavailable before any work call; chDeTickOutcome maps zero-call unavailable to unavailable.

signed_unresolved_paths.case: Malformed/inconsistent tick report or unequal started/settled calls; interrupted/stopped result not satisfying exact complete/exhausted contract; nonzero unconfirmed/unavailable/invalid/deferred counters.

Resume performs only rule_research for the supplied original operationId/leaseId. Unconfirmed/unavailable/invalid/collision, backoff/superseded, incomplete terminal result or uncaught worker failure does not prove publication.
The exact request family cannot be selected because retained execution/queue/confirm/epoch/lease/canonical row evidence is missing, blocked, inconsistent or out of budget; return unconfirmed.
Native operation report/receipt decoding, method authority, deadline or actual-drain failure; poisoned transport or other worker unavailable also reaches unresolved once a work call started.
Abort after dispatched=true or an exception after dispatch returns unresolved; it does not prove rollback or safe replay.

terminal_block.rule: After processing a resume, phase_attempts>=8 or cycle age>=25minutes blocks the immutable cycle with retry_budget_exhausted; any existing blocked cycle prevents opening another cycle.
terminal_block.cycle12: Eight attempts within ten minutes establish the attempt cap as the triggering terminal condition. This is the scheduler stop condition, not the underlying cause of the first503.

code_proven_interpretation.immutable_history_rule: preserve_request_v1 rejects changes to the original request identity and any transition from a terminal row. No update/delete/reset/reuse of Cycle12 is a permitted repair.
code_proven_interpretation.original_queue_custody: A retained claim is selected only through the existing original execution/queue/confirm predicates; a negative or blocked lookup is never authority to create/replay a new claim.

unproven_hypotheses.name: BG1 scheduled source-admission refusal for dispatch40
unproven_hypotheses.support: Dispatch40 was issued2026-11-16T07:45:00.093842Z and is the sole unavailable response; the code excludes the first35s of each five-minute UTC period and the last35s before its next slot.
unproven_hypotheses.limitations: Dispatch timestamp is not the method-precheck execution timestamp. Historical Production deployment/request-stage log binding is missing. The seven unresolved responses cannot all be explained by this single precheck refusal.

unproven_hypotheses.name: Expired Cycle12 claim or open native attempt prevents progress
unproven_hypotheses.support: One expired job lease is present in the aggregate latest read; the SQL has no kind/CH-DE filter. Native selected-claim logic refuses absent/inconsistent custody.
unproven_hypotheses.limitations: No archived Cycle12 operationId/leaseId-to-job/claim/subject join was observed. Do not call the aggregate lease the cause. A lease observed expired six days later may be a consequence rather than the initial failure.

unproven_hypotheses.name: Worker budget, method/transport, native START/intake, source validation or publication settlement failure
unproven_hypotheses.support: All are potential code paths to the same unresolved wire status.
unproven_hypotheses.limitations: No retained stage result, platform request correlation or linked original custody record identifies which path actually failed.

minimal_readonly_preparation.transaction: BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='15s'; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='2s'; SET LOCAL idle_in_transaction_session_timeout='20s'; ... ROLLBACK;
scope: Fixed Cycle12 plus its nine dispatch rows only, not all scheduler history.
Bounded optional one matching CH-DE subject selected through exact deterministic Cycle12 identities; count guard rejects >1.
At most five original/derived claim generations, their known queue/execution rows and linked metadata; fixed per-relation caps and explicit overflow flags.
Known pg_catalog function/column/owner/privilege metadata needed to decode that fixed current shape; unknown/missing mandatory shape stops before data decoding.
Retain source/subject/record bytes as SHA256/length and selected typed fields; exclude source bodies, tokens, secret values, actor PII and unrelated history.
do_not_invoke: Any jobs/intake execute, claim, mutation, publisher, renewal, source or HTTP routine
Any guard resume/recovery or Owner authority action
Any catalog assertion whose implementation has not been verified as read-only
Any retry, second diagnostic read or fallback scan after error/unknown shape
minimal_readonly_preparation.stop_rules: Any error, missing mandatory relation/function, unknown shape, more than one matching subject, ambiguous identity join, row/output/time overflow or partial response: stop, no retry, no writes.
minimal_readonly_preparation.interpretation_limit: The read can bind the actual current blocker and a safe terminal action. It cannot fabricate lost historical runtime diagnostics or establish that a future retry will succeed.

implementation_decision.terminal_close_can_be_prepared_only_afte: Exact original custody and technical review are bound. Use a reviewed append-only technical receipt and successor; preserve old Cycle12 and its failures.
implementation_decision.resume_requires: Current source/method/BG1 evidence, a supported unchanged native CAS path with existing authority, original custody closed safely, exact new IDs and immutable caps, Dev/native negative and positive proofs, and a separate Production Go.
known_unsafe_shortcuts: Updating Cycle12 state, phase_attempts or request IDs
Deleting the blocked cycle or failure/START/queue evidence
Calling an expired lease a valid new lease, or reusing original IDs for a new source attempt
Granting roles/permissions or bypassing native original-custody checks
Treating BG1 current, HTTP200 queued or AT transport repair as accepted CH-DE facts
Presenting a generic retry as a proven repair of the original503 cause
implementation_decision.dev_receipt_limit: The21Nov Dev-cycle5 retirement independently proves that exact Dev closure only. Its identities, counters, Owner receipt and authority do not transfer to Production cycle12.
